name: openforms
description: Ethical, self-hostable open-source alternative to Google Forms — SvelteKit + ElysiaJS + Prisma on Bun.

scripts.test: bun run --cwd backend test && bun run --cwd frontend test
scripts.check: bun run --cwd backend check && bun run --cwd frontend check
scripts.build: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 bun run --cwd backend build && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 bun run --cwd frontend build
scripts.db:setup: bun run db:migrate && bun run db:seed
